exact_claim: On the finite shell 0 < r_in < R < ∞, the external-Newtonian baryon virial term of the equilibrium phantom rho(r) = A/r^2 (A = C/(4 pi G_N), C = sqrt(G_N M_b a0)) in the point-mass well Phi_b = -G_N M_b/r is exactly W_bar = -∫ rho r dPhi_b/dr dV = -4 pi G_N M_b A ln(R/r_in) = -M_b C ln(R/r_in); the virial (work) form equals the potential form ∫ rho Phi_b dV (r dPhi_b/dr = -Phi_b), dW_bar/dR = 4 pi R^2 rho(R) Phi_b(R), and G091's verbatim expression -M_b C ln(r_break/r_b) is reproduced on [r_b, r_break] (domain r ≥ r_b > 0 stated). The term diverges logarithmically as r_in -> 0 (no baryonic core; rate M_b C ln 10 per decade, measured to 50 digits) and as R -> ∞ (no outer edge: full-kernel error -M_b C ln(R_max/R) unbounded; physical outer edge beyond the registered 0.62 r_M cap is an open dependency). Inserted in the G091 closed virial chain 2T + W_self + W_bar = 3 P_s V with the isothermal fluid closure it gives sigma^2 = (C/2)[1 + (1/lam) ln(r_break/r_b)] -> C/2 exactly at r_b = r_break (any lam, any M_b); the bare (boundary-term-free) reading gives (C/3)[...] = (2/3)·(C/2)[...], so C/2 is not a bare-virial consequence. Exact identity on the whole stated domain; both footings (a0 = 9.3619e-11 and 1.1279e-10 m/s^2, kappa = 1/2 adopted per footing with separate rho_Lambda = 4 a0^2/(G_N c^2)); G_N used only, G_bare/G_cosmo separate and untouched.
